<style>
.phantom-comeback-home{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:radial-gradient(circle at 78% 28%,rgba(122,92,255,.18),transparent 25rem),rgba(255,255,255,.008)}
.phantom-comeback-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(300px,.72fr);gap:54px;align-items:center}
.phantom-comeback-copy{max-width:640px}
.phantom-home-tagline{margin:8px 0 18px;color:#ddd5f3;font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;font-size:16px;font-style:italic;letter-spacing:.08em}
.phantom-home-desc{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.9}
.phantom-release-meta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:24px 0}
.phantom-release-meta span{padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid rgba(184,168,255,.2);background:rgba(8,7,15,.48);color:#d8d1ee;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.13em}
.phantom-release-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.phantom-scheduler-card{display:block;width:min(100%,470px);justify-self:end;border:1px solid rgba(184,168,255,.25);background:#05050b;box-shadow:0 0 36px rgba(122,92,255,.15);overflow:hidden}
.phantom-scheduler-card img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;filter:saturate(.94) brightness(.96);transition:transform .35s ease,filter .35s ease}
.phantom-scheduler-card:hover img{transform:scale(1.012);filter:saturate(1) brightness(1)}
.hero-debut{margin:16px 0 0;color:#d8cff6;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase}
@media(max-width:860px){.phantom-comeback-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.phantom-scheduler-card{justify-self:start;max-width:520px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.phantom-release-actions{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}.phantom-release-actions .btn{text-align:center}}
</style>


<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/css/home-cleanup.css">
